facts.fact: The regulator ARPCE takes consumer complaints through its listening centre and treated seven complaints about mobile financial services in the second quarter of 2022, per its quarterly complaints observatory.
facts.system: ARPCE Observatoire des plaintes des consommateurs

facts.fact: ARPCE reported complaint figures for Q2 2022: 25 complaints in all, with financial services 28%, mostly scams, blocked accounts and wrong transfers.
